lines.say: Five facts about honeybees that will change how you see them.
lines.caption: 5 honeybee facts
lines.cap: Five facts about honeybees that will change how you see them.

lines.say: One. Bees dance to give directions. The waggle dance tells the hive which way the flowers are, and how far.
lines.caption: Waggle dance
lines.cap: One. Bees dance to give directions. The waggle dance tells the hive which way the flowers are, and how far.

lines.say: Two. A honeybee has five eyes. Two big ones, and three tiny ones on top of its head.
lines.caption: Five eyes
lines.cap: Two. A honeybee has five eyes. Two big ones, and three tiny ones on top of its head.

lines.say: Three. Its wings beat about two hundred times every second. That's the buzz you hear.
lines.caption: 200 beats a second
lines.cap: Three. Its wings beat about 200 times every second. That's the buzz you hear.

lines.say: Four. One worker bee makes only about a twelfth of a teaspoon of honey in her whole life.
lines.caption: 1/12 teaspoon
lines.cap: Four. One worker bee makes only about a twelfth of a teaspoon of honey in her whole life.

lines.say: Five. Bees shiver their flight muscles to keep the nursery warm, at about thirty-five degrees Celsius.
lines.caption: 35 °C
lines.cap: Five. Bees shiver their flight muscles to keep the nursery warm, at about 35 °C.
